hero.title: Start with the question.
hero.subtitle: STOA helps your child work through the next step, with teacher support when it is needed.
hero.proofBody: A teacher can step in when a hint is not enough.

learningThread.title: The next step becomes clear.
learningThread.subtitle: A question can move from the first unsure moment to the right kind of support.

beats.title: A question appears.
beats.body: Start with the part that no longer makes sense.

beats.title: The next step takes shape.
beats.body: A hint helps the work continue without giving the answer away.

beats.title: A teacher can step in.
beats.body: Some questions need more than a hint. STOA leaves room for that.

beats.title: Learning becomes clearer at home.
beats.body: Parents can see what was practised, where support helped, and what comes next.

parentConfidence.title: A clearer view of learning.
parentConfidence.body: See what your child is working on, where support helped, and what is ready for the next study session.

note.title: Fractions are in focus
note.body: Your child practised equivalent fractions and used support when the method became unclear.

trustLayer.title: Support, with a sense of proportion.
trustLayer.body: A hint when it helps. A teacher when it matters. No promise that learning should be rushed.
trustLayer.caption: A learning signal, not a live feed.

principles.title: The work stays educational
principles.body: Support points to the next step, not to a shortcut around the learning.

principles.title: The student keeps the work
principles.body: STOA can guide the moment without taking the question away.

principles.title: A teacher when it matters
principles.body: When a question needs a person, the path to teacher support is part of the experience.

principles.title: No inflated promises
principles.body: Progress is treated as practice, support, and time with the material.

trustLayer.footnote: Assurance comes from how the service behaves: clear enough for parents, spacious enough for learning.

finalCta.title: Start with the question in front of you.
finalCta.body: One question is enough to begin.
